pieces.title: Types of Intelligence
pieces.description: We built one kind of mind. You're the other — and the difference is the most practical thing you can know about working with it. The whole case, as one continuous scroll.

pieces.title: Who Picked the Headphones
pieces.description: Six AIs, one two-sentence request. Watch where the details in the output actually come from — and find the gap where your intention was supposed to go.
